item.title: COVID-19 – Temporary Studio Shutdown
item.description: As of tomorrow, Friday March 13th 2020, we will close down our studio in K-Nippes for all regular live broadcasts due to the ongoing spread of COVID-19. We'll keep on replaying older shows though 24/7 to make sure the music will not stop, and suggest checking our Twitter account for all updates and news regarding dublab

item.title: Save Our Studio
item.description: Strange times indeed. The current crisis has hit many musicians, artists, initiatives and cultural institutions, and dublab DE is no exception. Without income from regular events such as our monthly “Future Roots Night” at Acephale we cannot cover ongoing expenses like office and studio rent, server costs or GEMA fees, which add up to roughly […]

item.title: Save Our Studio – Half Time
item.description: 7 days down, 7 to go: We're halfway through our 2 week long "Save Our Studio" initiative, and wanted to take this opportunity to thank all of you for the overwhelming support we experienced over the last days.

item.title: Save Our Studio – We Did It
item.description: We - as in "you and us" - did it. The Save Our Studio weeks are over, and the level of support we experienced has been overwhelming. Your positive feedback secured our office and studio rent for months to come, has given us a feeling of safety and provided confidence for future projects ahead. Thank you on so many levels!

item.title: A Way Forward
item.description: Dear listeners. While we continue with our live program we're equally disturbed and moved by the current events unfolding in the US, which for us are only part of a much bigger, systemic problem that persists all over the world. Rising inequality, politics that benefit few instead of many, and the lack of accountability for those in power. This has to change, and we're currently contemplating a responsible way forward amidst these trying times.

item.title: Mapping The Collection – Museum Ludwig Radio Special
item.description: We’re teaming up with Museum Ludwig Köln for a radio special about the forthcoming “Mapping the Collection” exhibition on July 2nd, 2020. The special is part of the museum’s ongoing late night series entitled “Langer Donnerstag”, and was originally set to happen live at Museum Ludwig in May. item.title: Meakusma Festival – Service Announcement
item.description: Dear listeners, This weekend the Meakusma Festival in Belgium returns for the fifth time - albeit in an adapted version - and quite a few people got in touch over the last days to ask us why we are not involved anymore, so we feel compelled to answer.

item.title: dublab Space Opening
item.description: Exciting news! dublab will open a small, public music space in a central location at Hansaring 94 in Cologne. Join us for the Opening with B<ex Burch and Themes For Great Cities on October 27+28, 2023.

item.title: dublab & Carhartt WIP – Capsule Collection
item.description: Carhartt WIP and Los Angeles-based radio platform dublab are celebrating the station’s 25th anniversary, with a global tour and collaborative capsule collection.
